params.body:
A member of gentells.com may browse and use Ask, and nothing else. The pipeline holds that (gentells-pipeline `workbench/member-access`, merge it first); this makes the screens match.

- **Standard** leaves the guest's screens: out of `GUEST_PATHS`, gone from the Data menu, and a typed `/standard` lands on the Overview.
- **Ask** is on the bar for a guest. In the panel a guest gets no model choice, no "start a piece in the Studio", examples about what they read, and a line with the questions left today. At the daily number the panel says so plainly, with the time it opens again in the reader's own clock, and the input closes.
- **Atlas**: "Explain this chain" is hidden from a guest. It is a free-form model call the pipeline refuses to a guest.
- **Accounts**: the team role `client` is labelled Writer instead of Member. "Member" sat one line above the "Members of gentells.com" list, who are not on the team.

Checked in a browser as a member signed in through gentells.com, against a local pipeline: every guest page sends no write, and its only buttons are paging, filters and time windows.

e2e 51/51 (guest menu, typed `/standard`, the guest's Ask panel, the cap message), lint ratchet equal, build green.
params.title: A gentells.com member gets Ask, loses the Standard, and the team role reads Writer
